content.rationale: Recording is where D13's named purpose (rvyrosmp), D6's attribution (roqpxulw), D21's id refusal with its name and its excluded effects (tnqpoqxl, tsspuwzo, xtmprysl, qyynqqpx), the map-to-no-node rule (uzlvzrpv), the form's flag grammar (the path-less and unnameable-argument refusals and order-free recognition), the path that cannot be placed (R4), confinement (xklsyrrv), no birth (lypvkskv), O7-record's silence (wvqzoqvx), S3-status's changed set, S2-own's ownership rule and S3-place's mechanism meet; this check drives the handler over a scratch jj workspace whose node files are named by real change ids, and pins each of those, including a rename both of whose paths the target's ref covers placing as the one move, plus that the handler is the table's shape — a Verb row for it compiles (M-route). It also pins that the surface answers before the store is taken (H1, `qtqnuqxo`): --help and an unnamed argument answer on a root-less context, the argument named rather than the workspace. It also pins that a recording whose target is the change the working copy is already on moves nothing, so it appends no marker and leaves the marker file untouched. It reaches store_load through store_resolve, so it is a crate of its own. I1-serde (orrvsxqq) fixes the JSON layer the crate is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive — and I1-schema (zmmyomyp) fixes the validator these documents are checked with. It pins the read's refusal site (S2-read-refusal-site, vollyzvn): a target whose document cannot be read refuses, naming it. Its amendment adds the source form `record --from <handle> --to <node> [path...]` (uvrltuvo, vmwvnnzv): the same crate lands one open draft over the same scratch jj repository, reading `.deccy/work/<handle>.json` through the flat draft registry (rroqqrzq) and the node's content-identity base through the identity module (ttkuyvxp, qrqsxyzz), and pins that the changed owned paths enter the node's change, the record's one document turns `landed` inside that recording (vkkwusty, qvkuluyw), a `--to` naming another node or an absent handle refuses and places nothing, a stale open record — including a stale sibling naming the same node — refuses naming its handle and differing paths (ptlmptoy), and the state write adds no marker of its own while the landing keeps exactly one recording (qvkuluyw). The registry read's refusal is the one the landing relies on for an absent handle (ntypuupx). This amendment holds the source form's four remaining rules, each stated by uvrltuvo and each pinned with a positive control so that a refusal cannot pass merely because the source form is absent: `[path...]` given with `--from` must state the changed owned set exactly, so a named subset and a named path that is not a changed owned path each refuse and place nothing while the exact set lands; a record whose `edit` is the target owning change id refuses and places nothing while the same draft naming its own edit lands; a record already `landed` refuses and places nothing while the same record open lands; and a deletion of an owned path that the draft carries is a changed owned path, so it is placed into the target change and the record turns `landed`. This amendment covers the landing of a described draft, which the source form's amendment above left unpinned: it pinned that the changed owned paths enter the node's change, and named neither the draft's workspace carrying a description of its own nor the node's change keeping the description it had. A recording places the named edits and nothing else (rvyrosmp, uvrltuvo), and inside the one recording the only other thing is the record's `landed` write (qvkuluyw), so joining two described changes is a placement that asks no one to combine or choose a description and leaves the node's change with the description it carried — and that description is the node's summary, the `jj log` description the log verb lists (S3-log, lrqyktxp, qtuoknos), so a landing that rewrote or merged it would rewrite the node's summary. The check drives the source form over the same scratch jj workspace with the draft's working copy and the node's change both described, and with `JJ_EDITOR` naming an editor that leaves a marker and fails, so a landing that opens an editor fails the crossing rather than editing a description. It pins that the landing returns normally with nothing on stdout (O7-record), that the editor was never opened, that the node's change still carries its own description, that the draft's changed owned path is in the node's change, that the record's one document turns `landed` (vkkwusty), that no node is created, and that the landing is one recording.
